description: The dataset records peat core measurements from Stordalen_2 (68.35 °N, 19.05 °E, 350 m elevation). Sediment depth ranges from 0 to 2.225 m and sample thickness up to 1.0 m, both geological measurements. Radiocarbon ages for 14 years span 0 to 2003, with uncertainties of 0.03–0.09 yr. Material types (moss, sphagnum, Carex/Betula) are linked to laboratory labels, and all records share the Event “Stordalen_2”. These data enable reconstruction of peat accumulation, past climate and vegetation, and calibration of geochronological models.
